map.两全为什么比定期贵？: Why is endowment pricier than term?
map.满期一定返还(确定现金流)拉高现值，身故保障再加一层，故保费高于纯身故定期险。: The certain maturity return (a guaranteed cash flow) raises the PV, and death protection adds a layer, so the premium exceeds pure-death term insurance.
map.两全到期返还算不算白赚？: Is the endowment maturity return a free gain?
map.不是。满期金是投保人自己的储蓄返还，保费中生存给付部分按预定利率积存，只是把定期: No. The maturity sum is the policyholder's own savings returned; the survival-benefit portion accrues at the valuation rate — it is just term insurance bundled with a savings plan, and the total cost is not below the sum of the two.
map.两全保险年缴保费（现值均衡）：折现 v = 1 ÷ (1+i)；身故给付现值 =: Annual premium of an endowment policy (present-value equalisation): discount v = 1 ÷ (1+i); PV of death benefit = Σ B·v^t·ₜp·q (survival probability ₜp starting at 1 and multiplying by (1−q) each year); PV of maturity benefit = B·vⁿ·ₙp; annual premium P = (death PV + maturity PV) ÷ annuity-due factor a, a = (1−vⁿ) ÷ i. Validation: all four fields are required valid numbers (a blank field no longer falls back to 0); sum insured > 0, 0 ≤ q < 1 (q > 1 makes survival probabilities negative), i > −1 (i = 0 is blocked by the denominator guard), and policy years must be a positive integer from 1 to 1000 (fractional or oversized values are no longer silently truncated). Otherwise a prompt stops the run, the old detail table is cleared, and no history entry or export is produced. Rule: no fixed grading; the maturity benefit must be multiplied by the survival probability at maturity, otherwise the PV is overstated by about 19%.
